Enterprise AI Advisory Services

We provide focused advice on AI strategy, architecture, security and cloud readiness. Our work helps organisations evaluate options and plan implementation with greater clarity.

AI Strategy & Roadmap

Determine where AI is useful and what it will take to introduce it.

What we do

Assess business opportunities, technical feasibility, existing capabilities and investment priorities.

What you receive

A prioritised set of AI opportunities, recommendations and an implementation roadmap.

AI Architecture & Integration

Plan how AI will work within your existing technology environment.

What we do

Evaluate application architecture, data access, integration patterns and solution options.

What you receive

Architecture recommendations, key design decisions and integration guidance.

AI Security & Governance

Understand and address the risks of enterprise AI adoption.

What we do

Review identity, data protection, access controls, cloud security and governance requirements.

What you receive

A security and governance assessment with prioritised recommendations.

AI Agents & Intelligent Automation

Assess where AI agents and automation can support business workflows.

What we do

Evaluate candidate processes, integration needs, human oversight and operational risks.

What you receive

Use-case recommendations, solution options and a practical validation approach.

AI Cloud Readiness & Scalability

Prepare your cloud architecture for AI workloads.

What we do

Assess AWS or Azure infrastructure, scalability, reliability, monitoring and cost considerations.

What you receive

A cloud readiness review and recommended architecture improvements.

AI Implementation & Value Realisation

This service is an optional follow-on to our advisory engagements, supporting clients who need help implementing the recommendations.

What we do

Implement agreed AI solutions, integrate them with enterprise systems and prepare them for operation.

What you receive

An implemented solution within the agreed scope, deployment documentation and validation against defined success criteria.

Flagship engagement

Enterprise AI Transformation Blueprint

  • Prioritised AI opportunities.
  • Architecture recommendations.

  • Implementation roadmap.
  • Key decisions and next steps.
